note: The explainer videos, as data. The same list as README.md and BRIEF.md in this folder; web/test.mjs checks it against the Learn page. 'basis' says what the video describes: 'built' runs today, 'design' is a board that is designed and not built, 'plan' is mostly proposals.

videos.title: One seed phrase, one point of failure
videos.idea: A seed phrase is a single point of failure. A multisig removes it, and Picoquorum is a new kind of owner to put in one.

videos.title: Two of three: a multisig in two minutes
videos.idea: A multisig is a shared account that needs several approvals, so no one person and no one mistake can move the money.

videos.title: The multisig is the wallet
videos.idea: Wallets of every kind hold a seed phrase. Picoquorum is a cosigner with a sealed key, and the multisig is the wallet.

videos.title: One approval, start to finish
videos.idea: An approval is a thing you do with your hands: read every page, check the code, hold Sign.

videos.title: Inside the console
videos.idea: Three zones: the cable, which is not trusted; the console, which rebuilds and shows the transaction; and the key, which signs.

videos.title: When the hardware fails
videos.idea: Every way the box can fail ends in the same place: one owner's vote, lost or misused.

videos.title: A new key, from the bench to your Safe
videos.audience: someone about to get a key
videos.idea: The bench marks the chip and makes no key. Your console checks the mark, then makes the key in front of you. Funds go to your Safe.

videos.title: A key with no backup
videos.idea: The key can't be copied. That makes it safe to hold, and it is why the other owners are the backup.

videos.title: What it protects, and what it doesn't
videos.idea: It guards against a lying screen and a leaked secret. It does not guard itself: no PIN, no fingerprint.
